tools.name: unica.view
tools.description: Inspect the workspace with no arguments, or read one logical 1C node by address.

at.description: Qualified logical address: <sourceSet>:<Kind>[.<Name>...]. Omit only for workspace bootstrap where allowed.

filter.description: Optional projection such as sections; valid only with at.

limit.description: Maximum child items to return; valid only with at.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from an earlier addressed view.

tools.name: unica.apply
tools.description: Preview or atomically apply typed edits to one logically addressed 1C node.

at.description: Qualified logical address: <sourceSet>:<Kind>[.<Name>...]. Omit only for workspace bootstrap where allowed.

ops.description: Ordered operations advertised by the target node's can data.

op.description: Operation name from the target node's can data.

dryRun.description: Validate and return the plan without publishing when true.

ifRev.description: Revision returned by a prior dryRun preview; required when dryRun is false.

tools.name: unica.resolve
tools.description: Emergency bridge between a logical address and the source layout, in both directions. Use it only when a path arrived from outside Unica - a diff, a build log, a stack trace - or when a file has to be opened outside Unica. To find an object by name use search; to read it use view.

at.description: Qualified logical address whose source location is needed.

path.description: Path to a source file or object directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: unica.search
tools.description: Search one corpus for a query: BSL module text, or the names and synonyms of metadata objects. Optionally under one logical subtree.

query.description: Literal BSL text, symbol, or metadata name to search for.

corpus.description: Where to search: `text` matches BSL module content and answers scope, line, column and snippet; `names` matches metadata names and synonyms and answers at, kind and title. Defaults to `text`.

kind.description: `names` corpus only: narrow the search to one logical node kind.

role.description: `text` corpus only: which provider answers. `lexical` matches literally, `symbol` uses the symbol index, `semantic` matches by meaning. Omit for the literal search Unica performs itself.

regex.description: Request regex matching; currently only false is implemented.

tools.name: unica.check
tools.description: Confirm workspace source-set admission, or validate one logical node: readability plus every validator its kind owns.

at.description: Qualified logical address: <sourceSet>:<Kind>[.<Name>...]. Omit only for workspace bootstrap where allowed.

tools.name: unica.diff
tools.description: Compare two readable logical nodes of the same kind without changing files.

left.description: Qualified logical address of the left node.

right.description: Qualified logical address of the right node.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from an earlier diff.

tools.name: unica.run
tools.description: List canonical runtime operations and their invocation contract, or preview/execute one implemented operation.

op.description: Canonical operation name; omit to list operation status.

args.description: Typed arguments for the selected operation.

dryRun.description: Required by previewApply operations: true returns a non-mutating plan and revision; false requires ifRev and applies that plan.

ifRev.description: Revision returned by a prior preview of the same previewApply operation; required when dryRun is false.

tools.name: unica.docs
tools.description: Search bundled Unica and safe 1C documentation by topic.

source.description: Optional documented source kind, not a provider identity.

tools.name: unica.task.get
tools.description: Read the current durable Task state immediately without waiting or re-running the subject tool.

taskId.description: Opaque Task identifier returned by Unica

tools.name: unica.task.result
tools.description: Wait for a Task result for a bounded interval; returns the canonical result or a new working receipt without re-running the subject tool.

taskId.description: Opaque Task identifier returned by Unica

waitMs.description: Bounded wait in milliseconds; defaults to 7000

tools.name: unica.task.cancel
tools.description: Idempotently request cancellation and return the current durable Task state without re-running the subject tool.

taskId.description: Opaque Task identifier returned by Unica
